name: Covenant

rounds.endCondition: Game ends after the third Council phase (Era marker on last space); then final scoring

categories.label: Glory Points on track before final scoring
categories.labelVi: Điểm vinh quang trên track (trước tổng kết)
categories.hint: GP accumulated during play: project tiles each Council, dungeon enemies, tradition tiles, actions.

categories.label: King's Throne GP
categories.hint: Most/2nd/3rd most carts at the Throne (min 1 cart): 6/3/1 GP. Ties broken by carts on higher levels; if still tied all get full points.

categories.label: Revealed objective tiles
categories.hint: Total GP from objective tiles shown: 1 tile with 4+ achievements, 2 tiles with 8+. Values per tile are on the rulebook p.40.

categories.label: Halls with your presence and an enemy
categories.labelVi: Sảnh có công trình của bạn và có kẻ địch
categories.hint: -2 GP per hall tile where you have a building and at least 1 enemy (pillar up to 3 halls, gate up to 2).

categories.label: Tool column bonuses (total GP)
categories.hint: Per column with forged tools (max 2): relic types x tools, dungeon enemies x tools, districts with presence x tools, pillars/gates x tools. Sum all columns.

categories.label: Supports and leftover resources (units)
categories.labelVi: Support và tài nguyên còn lại (số đơn vị)
categories.hint: 1 GP for every 3 combined units of support pieces and resources.

tiebreakers.description: If still tied, victory is shared.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. throne GP is entered as the resulting 6/3/1/0 (level-based tiebreak is resolved by the scorer). Objective tile values and tool-column bonuses depend on board state and are entered as GP totals. Solo mode (Council of the Elders) not modelled. Rulebook is image-only; read from page renders, pp.26-29 and 38-40.

sources.title: Covenant rulebook (Devir, EN)
sources.section: p.26 Council phase; pp.27-29 Final scoring; p.38-39 Projects; p.40 Objectives
